facts.en: Completed a transport visitor-services certificate at Fictional Baylark College in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构湾雀学院完成交通游客服务证书课程。

facts.en: Paid check-in assistant at Fictional Petrelstep Ferry Terminal from 2022-07 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-07 至 2026-08 在虚构海燕阶渡轮码头任有薪乘船报到助理。

facts.en: Checked foot-passenger booking references and departure dates against the terminal’s booking screen.
facts.zh: 依据码头预订屏幕核对步行乘客的预订编号及出发日期。

facts.en: Issued check-in slips after completing the desk’s supplied document-check procedure.
facts.zh: 完成柜台提供的证件核验流程后，发放乘船报到凭条。

facts.en: Referred mismatched names or changed journeys to the senior ticketing clerk rather than overriding the booking.
facts.zh: 将姓名不匹配或行程变更转交高级票务文员，而非覆盖预订。

facts.en: Directed checked-in passengers to the gate named on the current departure board.
facts.zh: 将已办理乘船报到手续的乘客指引至当前出发信息板所列登船口。

facts.en: Read delay and gate-change messages from text approved by the terminal duty manager.
facts.zh: 按码头值班经理批准的文字播读延误及登船口变更消息。

facts.en: Recorded passenger assistance requests and passed them to the designated terminal assistance team.
facts.zh: 记录乘客协助请求，并转交指定码头协助团队。

facts.en: Helped test a clearer group-booking check-in sheet in 2025-04.
facts.zh: 2025-04 协助测试更清晰的团体预订乘船报到表。

facts.en: Personally added individual check-in boxes beneath the shared booking reference; the senior clerk approved the layout.
facts.zh: 个人在共用预订编号下添加个人报到勾选框；高级文员批准版式。

facts.en: A 2025-05 desk check found completed individual check-in boxes for 44 of 46 sampled passengers across 7 group bookings.
facts.zh: 2025-05 柜台检查发现，7 笔团体预订中抽样的 46 名乘客有 44 名的个人报到框已填写。

facts.en: The desk check concerned check-in records; it did not establish who ultimately boarded or completed the voyage.
facts.zh: 该柜台检查涉及乘船报到记录；未确立谁最终登船或完成航程。

facts.en: Uses a booking lookup screen, ticket scanner and written shift exception log.
facts.zh: 使用预订查询屏幕、验票扫描器及书面轮班异常日志。

facts.en: Handed unresolved booking discrepancies to the next desk shift with the booking reference and action already taken.
facts.zh: 将未解决预订差异交接给下一柜台班次，附上预订编号及已采取措施。

facts.en: Completed the terminal’s internal passenger-assistance and evacuation-contact orientation in 2022-07.
facts.zh: 2022-07 完成码头内部乘客协助及疏散联系入门培训。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Willowtide Community Cycle Day in 2020-08, tagging parked bicycles and matching numbered claim slips at collection.
facts.zh: 2020-08 在虚构柳潮社区骑行日做志愿者，为停放自行车贴标签，并在领取时匹配编号领取凭条。

facts.en: Made a personal illustrated guide to 6 invented seaside landmarks in 2023, without publishing it as a travel service.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人图解指南，介绍 6 处虚构海滨地标，未将其作为旅游服务发布。

facts.en: Enjoys assembling decorative shell-shaped mosaics from colored card.
facts.zh: 爱好用彩色卡纸拼贴装饰性贝壳形马赛克。

facts.en: All recorded paid duties were land-based terminal services; the candidate was not part of the vessel crew.
facts.zh: 记录中的全部有薪职责均为陆上码头服务；候选人不属于船舶船员。
